beaujolais-golden-stone-roads.title: Beaujolais Golden Stone Roads
beaujolais-golden-stone-roads.slogan: A 198 km loop out of Oingt golden village
beaujolais-golden-stone-roads.story: Vineyards, stone villages and low-stress sweepers. Out of Theizé and back again: 198 km, roughly 3 h 48 in the saddle. It goes by way of Beaujeu vineyard road, Cluny stone town and Mâcon river. The climb of the day is Col des Écharmeaux. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.title: Norwegian Scenic Route Aurlandsfjellet
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 10.8%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Norwegian Scenic Route Aurlandsfjellet
scenicChapters.narrative: 1306 m come off over 37 km at around 6.6%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

norwegian-scenic-route-aurlandsfjellet.story: Out of Aurlandsvangen, one way: 62 km, roughly 1 h 04 in the saddle. It goes by way of Stegastein and near Aurlandsvangen. The highest point is about 1,300 m. Aurlandsfjellet high point is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
